chipintelli_sd_init_pins.message0: initialize CI13XX SD card SCK %1 MISO %2 MOSI %3 CS %4
chipintelli_sd_init_pins.tooltip: Initialize the SD card in setup with custom GPIO software-SPI pins in SCK, MISO, MOSI, CS order

chipintelli_sd_error_info.tooltip: Read the error code or additional error data from the most recent low-level SD operation

chipintelli_sd_end.message0: unmount CI13XX SD card and release software-SPI pins
chipintelli_sd_end.tooltip: Close the card and release software SPI, SCK, MISO, MOSI, and CS; initialize again before reuse

chipintelli_sd_exists.tooltip: Check whether a file or directory exists on the SD card

chipintelli_sd_path_operation.tooltip: Create a directory, delete a file, or remove an empty directory; mkdir also creates missing parent directories

chipintelli_sd_file_create.message0: open CI13XX SD path %1 mode %2 save as file %3
chipintelli_sd_file_create.tooltip: Create a File variable and open a file or directory; FILE_WRITE appends at the end of a file

chipintelli_sd_file_create_next.message0: CI13XX directory %1 open next entry mode %2 save as file %3
chipintelli_sd_file_create_next.tooltip: Get the next file or subdirectory from an open directory and save it in a new File variable

chipintelli_sd_file_is_open.tooltip: Check whether the File object is valid and open

chipintelli_sd_file_is_directory.tooltip: Check whether the current File object represents a directory

chipintelli_sd_file_name.tooltip: Return the 8.3 short name of the file or directory

chipintelli_sd_file_read.tooltip: Read or peek at the next byte; return -1 when no data is available, and peek does not advance the file position

chipintelli_sd_file_available.tooltip: Return the number of bytes currently available to read or write

chipintelli_sd_file_position.tooltip: Return the current read/write position or file size

chipintelli_sd_file_seek.message0: set CI13XX file %1 position to %2 successfully
chipintelli_sd_file_seek.tooltip: Move to the specified absolute byte offset and return whether it succeeded

chipintelli_sd_file_write.tooltip: Write with write, print, or println; the numeric base applies only to numeric print/println values

chipintelli_sd_file_control.tooltip: Flush the file, reset directory iteration, or close the File object
